message.text: Review policy and standards changed in this revision.

explanation.what: This revision changes AGENTS.md, which steers how Melian reviews this repository.
explanation.whatToDo: Have a maintainer read the change to AGENTS.md before merging.
explanation.whyHere: Melian reviewed the revision under the policy and standards it changes, so nothing it ran judged the new ones.

snippet.text: After the merge, the coordinator has a Sonnet agent draft the pull request's defect list for its comparison record: each distinct finding a reviewer raised on the first reviewed head, who raised it, and the commit that answered it or the builder's reply disputing it. The draft is evidence for adjudication, never the adjudication. Each finding is still judged valid, noise or duplicate as [the evals guideline](../guidelines/evals.md#comparisons) sets out, and [the shadow retirement rule](2026-10-06-shadow-retirement-merged-window.md) counts what it counted before: this decision changes neither.
